ED Conducts Fresh Raids in Kerala CMRL-Exalogic Case

The Enforcement Directorate (ED) conducted fresh raids at eight locations in Kozhikode, Kerala, as part of an ongoing money laundering probe related to the CMRL-Exalogic case. These searches are a follow-up to earlier raids on May 27, which included the residence of Chief Minister Pinarayi Vijayan's daughter, her husband, and his ancestral home. The action is being carried out under the Prevention of Money Laundering Act (PMLA).
